<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**18 people are killed and 78 others are injured in a [[Russia]]n missile strike which damaged an eight-storey building in a densely populated area of [[Chernihiv]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68833833 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-kills-people-ukraines-chernihiv-hits-infrastructure-governor-says-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Fourteen Israeli soldiers and four civilians injured in drone attacks in [[northern Israel]]. One IDF officer later succumbs.[https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hezbollah-launches-missiles-drones-northern-israel-wounding-14-israeli-soldiers-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)][https://www.timesofisrael.com/reservist-succumbs-to-wounds-sustained-in-hezbollah-drone-attack/  (The Times of Israel)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Taqaddum (Sudan)|Taqaddum]] leader and former [[Prime Minister of Sudan]] [[Abdalla Hamdok]] meets with [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] in [[Paris]], [[France]]. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/former-sudan-pm-hamdok-meets-macron-in-paris/ (Dabanga Sudan)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Vietnam]] announces a $24 billion rescue for the [[Sai Gon Joint Stock Commercial Bank]], which is currently involved in a fraud case. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/vietnam-mounts-unprecedented-24-billion-rescue-bank-engulfed-giant-fraud-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Persian Gulf floods]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates]] records its heaviest rainfall in 75 years, with significant flooding reported in [[Dubai]]. At least 20 people are killed by flooding in [[Oman]] and [[Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah|Ras Al Khaimah]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/17/dubai-floods-uae-rainfall-weather-forecast (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/dubai-international-airport-says-it-is-experiencing-significant-disruption-due-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)]
*Hundreds of people are evacuated after the [[Mount Ruang|Ruang volcano]] erupts in [[North Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hundreds-evacuated-after-indonesias-ruang-volcano-erupts-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis]]
**The Biden administration announces that it will reimpose oil sanctions on [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2024/04/17/venezuela-oil-sanctions-biden/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Switzerland]]'s [[Federal Assembly (Switzerland)|Federal Assembly]] votes to [[Swastika#Legislation in other European countries|ban public displays of the Nazi swastika]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/swiss-vote-ban-swastika-crackdown-extremist-symbols-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Croatian parliamentary election]]
**Voters in [[Croatia]] elect the members of the [[Croatian Parliament|Sabor]]. The ruling [[Croatian Democratic Union]] and its coalition win the most seats, but fail to obtain a majority. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/croatia-votes-popularity-test-long-ruling-hdz-2024-04-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Solomon Islands general election]]
**Voters in [[Solomon Islands]] elect a new [[National Parliament of Solomon Islands|National Parliament]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/17/solomon-islands-election-voters-head-to-polls-that-could-decide-future-of-china-security-ties (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Impeachment of Alejandro Mayorkas]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes to dismiss both impeachment articles against [[Homeland Security Secretary]] [[Alejandro Mayorkas]], by a vote of 51–48 on the first article and 51–49 on the second. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-senate-expected-swiftly-end-mayorkas-impeachment-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/04/17/politics/senators-vote-mayorkas-impeachment-dg/index.html (CNN)]

'''Science and technology'''
*Scientists announce that they have identified [[fossil]] remains of the ''[[Ichthyotitan]]'', the largest [[marine reptile]] currently known, in the [[Westbury Formation]] in [[England]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2517167-wetenschappers-vinden-fossiele-resten-van-grootste-zeereptiel-ooit (NOS)]

'''Sports'''
* In [[basketball]], the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] announces that it has banned [[Jontay Porter]], a [[Two-way contract|two-way player]] under contract to the [[Toronto Raptors]] and their [[NBA G League|G League]] affiliate [[Raptors 905]], for multiple major violations of the league's gambling policy. [https://www.nba.com/news/jontay-porter-banned-from-nba (NBA)] [https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39962406/nba-bans-raptors-jontay-porter-gambling-violations (ESPN)]
